data.summary: The documentation stage completed with tool observations indicating two code smells but no injection flags, lineage showing two upstream and one downstream connections, and an LLM draft of eight sections. No high‑severity findings were reported. However, gaps remain: hardcoded file paths, lack of monitoring plan, and missing development/validation data.
reasons: Hardcoded file paths are not documented or controlled.
No ongoing monitoring plan or thresholds are documented.
Development and validation data are not available in the repository, delaying validation.
